purpose: Two stationary precision-only observations on the frozen current cadence candidate; no browser, GPU, performance or human-fun acceptance.

strategy.attacks: Held tool1, nearest unobstructed living target every tick
strategy.stop: 30 cleared waves, real failure, 900 total simulation seconds or 120 seconds on one wave
strategy.mutationScope: Only original public start/step/discardDraft/chooseCombatUpgrade/resume; no production edits or simulation-state injection

phaseSampling: Pre-step wave/phase at fixed 1/60s; positions sampled at tick1/every60 ticks and per-wave boundaries; damage receipts include event-time phase, position and HP.
assertionPolicy: No forced victory, damage or failure. Real failures, timeouts and measurement errors retained; no seed replacement or retry.
